caption: The drawing depicts a single ornamental object with a three-dimensional appearance, positioned against a plain, off-white background. The object is a carved, shield-shaped piece with a pointed bottom and rounded top. It has a predominantly black base color and is decorated with intricate scrollwork and leaf motifs in a yellow-gold color. The design features two prominent curled elements near the center and top, with additional curving acanthus-like leaves extending diagonally upward and downward. The ornament’s surface shows shading to give the drawing a sense of depth and dimension, with the golden decorative patterns contrasting strongly against the dark background. There are no other objects or details in the composition besides the decorative carving.
title: Ship's Billethead
